senses.gloss: (Shaf. of דלל; cmp. דֶּלֶת) to swing, be wide open (v. Fr. Del. Proleg., p. 101).

units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 30b">Kidd. 30ᵇ</cite> sq. <he>גלוי … מפני שמְשַׁדַּלְתּוֹ בדברים וכ׳</he> it was revealed and known before Him … that a child honors his mother more than his father, because she sways him by persuasive words, therefore did he place the honor of the father before &c. (<cite ref="Exodus 20:12">Ex. XX, 12</cite>); Mekh. Yithro, s. 8; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 297">Yalk. Ex. 297</cite>.
<cite ref="Yoma 35b:8-11">Yoma 35ᵇ</cite> <he>בכל יום … משדלתו בדברים</he> every day did Potiphar’s wife try to win (entice) him with words; a. e.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:16:1">Koh. R. to I, 16</cite> <he>הלב מִשְׁתַּדֵּל וכ׳</he> the heart is enticed, as it is said (<cite ref="Genesis 34:3">Gen. XXXIV, 3</cite>), and he spoke &c.

senses.gloss: to make one’s self pleasant, to insinuate one’s self; to be on good terms.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 112a">Pes. 112ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 113a:10">113ᵃ</cite> <he>הוי משתדל עם וכ׳</he> try to be on good terms with him on whom the hour smiles.

senses.gloss: [to swing one’s self up,] to make an effort, strive.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Kiddushin 5:15">Tosef. Kidd. V, 15</cite> <he>לעולם יִשְׁתַּדֵּל אדם ללמד את בנו וכ׳</he> (not <he>לומד</he>) under all circumstances a man must strive to have his son taught a trade which is &c.; <cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 4:10">Kidd. IV, 10</cite> (<cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 4:11">11</cite>) Y. ed. (Mish. a. Babli only <he>ילמד</he>); Y. ib. IV, end, 66ᵈ.

<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 2:5">Ab. II, 5</cite> <he>במקום … הִשְׁתַּדֵּל להיות איש</he> (Ar. <he>השתדר</he>) where there are no men, strive thou to be a man. Ib. IV, 18 <he>אל תִּשְׁתַּדֵּל וכ׳</he> (Ar. <he>תשתדר</he>), v. <cite ref="S01419"><he>קַלְקָלָה</he></cite>; a. e.
